title: the events: their overlap with SWRs and the other detectors, their spike support, and their properties

animals.description: animals in the event table; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

animals_non_swr_majority.description: animals whose share of non-SWR events (the mean over their epochs) is above one half; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

animals_non_swr_more_at_well.description: animals whose non-SWR content is at a well more often than their SWR content, each share the mean over the animal's epochs; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

animals_non_swr_plurality.description: animals whose share of non-SWR events is the largest of their three overlap-class shares (each the mean over the animal's epochs); over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_animals_in_direction.description: animals whose non-SWR median number of arms the decoded position visits is lower than their SWR median, each the median over the animal's epochs of the epoch's median; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_difference_high.description: upper bound of that interval; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_difference_low.description: lower bound of the 95 % interval (nested bootstrap, small-sample t correction over the 5 animals) of the SWR minus non-SWR difference of median number of arms the decoded position visits; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_matched_difference.description: SWR minus non-SWR difference of median number of arms the decoded position visits at matched duration (within ten duration-quantile strata, averaged by stratum size); over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_matched_difference_high.description: upper bound of its 95 % interval (nested bootstrap, small-sample t correction over the 5 animals); over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_matched_difference_low.description: lower bound of its 95 % interval (nested bootstrap, small-sample t correction over the 5 animals); 0 of 1000 replicates left out a stratum that drew no event of a class, 0 had no estimate; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_median_non_swr.description: median number of arms the decoded position visits of immobile non-SWR non-local events; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

arms_median_swr.description: median number of arms the decoded position visits of immobile SWR-overlapping non-local events; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end)

baseline_dll_per_spike_median.description: median log-likelihood ratio per spike, decoded location against the animal's, of matched quiet windows; over the immobile non-local events that start inside a well visit (from the first poke-in at a well to the final poke-out; visit_context in_visit or spans_visit_end), against the matched quiet windows whose first sample is inside a well visit
baseline_dll_per_spike_median.source: Processed-Data/event_spike_evidence/*/event_spike_evidence_metrics.parquet (every event, no cap), each scored event matched to the event table by epoch and start, with each epoch's well visits
